# bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_extend

## Summary

Wrapper class for the HADDOCK3 extend module.

The HADDOCK3 extend. module continues the HADDOCK3 execution for docking of an already started run.

Nextflow adapter of the [Haddock3Extend](https://biobb-haddock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/haddock.html#module-haddock.haddock3_extend) building block of [biobb_haddock](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_haddock) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_EXTEND } from 'bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_extend'

workflow {
    BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_EXTEND(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_haddock_wf_data` | yes | zip | Path to the input zipball containing all the current Haddock workflow data |
| `haddock_config_path` | yes | cfg | Haddock configuration CFG file path |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_haddock_wf_data` | yes | zip | Path to the output zipball containing all the current Haddock workflow data |
| `versions_biobb_haddock` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_haddock', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Haddock3Extend properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_haddock_wf_data: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_haddock container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_EXTEND' {
        ext.properties = [global_cfg: [postprocess: true]]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cfg` | object | {} | Haddock configuration options specification. |
| `global_cfg` | object | {"postprocess": true} | Global configuration options specification. |
| `binary_path` | string | "haddock" | Path to the haddock haddock executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
